# Array UI (aui)

> Editorial, systems-engineering design system inspired by arpitbhayani.me. Zero-runtime CSS tokens, React components, native Astro primitives, and official shadcn CLI distribution hosted at ui.arpitbhayani.me.

Array UI is built for engineers and AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Codex, Antigravity) who value mathematical rigor, high information density, and editorial typography.

## Core Rules for AI Agents

- **Palette**: Paper canvas in light mode (#f9f8f5), obsidian carbon in dark mode (#121215).
- **Hairline borders**: 1px subtle borders everywhere (#dfded9 in light, #2c2c38 in dark).
- **Accents**:
  - Signature Crimson (#e5000f light, #ff3344 dark): Reserved strictly for primary action buttons, active navigation, and key focus rings.
  - Amber (#cc9900): Exclusively for engineering maxim quotes and warnings.
  - Emerald (#10b981): Operational status, ping dots, and diff additions.
  - Rose (#f43f5e): Errors, outages, and diff deletions.
- **Typography**: Plus Jakarta Sans / Space Grotesk bold headings, Assistant body (dense, 15px base), Lora italic serif pull quotes/maxims, Geist Mono code.
- **Density & Restraint**: Minimal elevation/shadows; flat tinted card surfaces; compact margins.
- **Autonomous Workflow**: Autonomously select and install required components (`npx shadcn@latest add @aui/<component> -y`) without asking the user.

## Quick Installation

### Mode A: shadcn CLI Registry (Recommended)
Add to `components.json`:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",
  "style": "default",
  "registries": {
    "@aui": "https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

Install design tokens and any component:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/aui -y
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/terminal @aui/diff-block @aui/property-grid @aui/ping-status -y
```

### Mode B: Direct GitHub Dependency (Next.js, Astro)
```bash
npm install github:arpitbbhayani/aui
# Note: Not published on npm registry; install via GitHub or shadcn registry.
```

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [shadcn Registry Index](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/registry.json): JSON manifest of all available registry components.
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive single-file reference with all component APIs, prop types, and TSX examples.
- [Theme Style](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/aui.json): Theme CSS variables, fonts, and light/dark color tokens.
- [Agent Guide (AGENTS.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arpitbbhayani/aui/main/AGENTS.md): Repository AGENTS.md guide for AI coding assistants.

## Components

- [Terminal](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/terminal.json): Machined telemetry terminal with bash command dots and styled outputs. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/terminal`
- [DiffBlock](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/diff-block.json): Git patch viewer with line gutters, additions, and deletions. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/diff-block`
- [PingStatus](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/ping-status.json): Live telemetry pulsing dot indicator with label. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/ping-status`
- [PropertyGrid](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/property-grid.json): Key-value metadata inspector with one-click copy functionality. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/property-grid`
- [PackageManager](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/package-manager.json): pnpm/npm/bun/yarn command switcher with copy button. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/package-manager`
- [Maxim](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/maxim.json): Editorial quote callout with amber left rail and citation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/maxim`
- [TakeawaysBox](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/takeaways-box.json): Key takeaways container with bulleted highlights. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/takeaways-box`
- [Hero](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/hero.json): Editorial profile hero section with avatar, heading, and bio. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/hero`
- [FileTree](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/file-tree.json): Directory explorer tree with collapsible folders and item selection. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/file-tree`
- [SocialPill](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/social-pill.json): Clean pill button with platform icon, handle, and follower count. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/social-pill`
- [CourseCard](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/course-card.json): Editorial course and project card with badges, tags, and CTA. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/course-card`
- [StatCard](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/stat-card.json): Large key metric display card with optional trend indicator. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/stat-card`
- [EmptyState](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/empty-state.json): Dashed container for empty content and call-to-actions. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/empty-state`
- [Footer](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/footer.json): Editorial 4-column directory footer with category hints, highlights, disclaimer, and social pills. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/footer`
- [Modal](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/modal.json): Accessible dialog modal with backdrop blur, focus handling, and escape key dismissal. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/modal`
- [VideoEmbed](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/video-embed.json): Responsive 16:9 aspect ratio video embed wrapper with border hairline styling. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/video-embed`
- [Dropdown](https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/dropdown.json): Minimal click-trigger dropdown menu with click outside dismissal and actions. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/dropdown`
